subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Midhuna was nineteen years old, too young to __buy the farm__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"buy the farm"** means to die or stop living. (मर जाना)

 
 
• **Example: **He was a brave soldier who** bought the farm** during the war.
 
 
 
• **"Stop living"** refers to the cessation of life or death. (जीवन समाप्त होना)
 
 
• **Example: **After a long and painful illness, he finally **stopped living.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Own a property** (संपत्ति का मालिक होना): To have legal ownership of a piece of land or building.

 
 
• **Example:** She dreams to own a property in the countryside someday.
 
 
 
• **Possess anything** (कुछ भी रखना): To have or hold something.
 
 
• **Example:** He possesses a rare collection of vintage cars.
 
 
 
• **Spend money** (पैसे खर्च करना): To use money to pay for something.
 
 
• **Example:** She loves to spend money on books and music.
 
 

 

11e:T133c,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
